issues.description: The problem statement instructs that the SealSaloon's stock should be initialized in the constructor (instance initialization) while elsewhere requiring the stock attribute to be static (shared across instances). Initializing a static final field in an instance constructor is not valid Java, so the two requirements conflict and will confuse or block students.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify and make the requirement consistent: either (A) require stock to be a static (class) field and instruct students to initialize it at declaration or in a static initializer (not the constructor), or (B) require stock to be a final instance field and remove the requirement that it should be static. Update the problem text and UML to match the chosen approach.
